file_write.scope: Only scripts/apply_arcsinh.py may create the two explicit new local outputs. It may read the two explicit local inputs, but may not replace a path, mutate inputs, create directories, use the network, or start a subprocess.
file_write.reason: The bounded helper publishes transformed events and their provenance; create-exclusive writes prevent replacement.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only the two caller-approved create-new local outputs; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only the two caller-approved create-new local outputs; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only the explicit transformed TSV and JSON report.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for both output paths.
